items.name: the-effect-explainer
items.title: The Effect: animated explainers
items.description: Two animated, voiced explainers of Nick Huntington-Klein's book The Effect: a detective case file and a field guide with pause-and-think cases.

items.name: learn-panchang
items.title: Panchang with Chandra
items.description: An animated, interactive guide to the Hindu calendar (Panchang): tithi, vara, nakshatra, yoga and karana, guided by Chandra the Moon.

items.name: igcse-grade8-explainers
items.title: Grade 8 IGCSE Explainers
items.description: Interactive, animated, narrated explainers for Grade 8 Cambridge Lower Secondary / IGCSE: physics, chemistry, biology and computer science.

items.name: claude-code-dojo
items.title: Claude Code Dojo with Sensei Shell
items.description: An interactive, Kokoro-narrated retro-terminal explainer with 22 hands-on lessons on using Claude Code well.

items.name: human-dna-explainer
items.title: DNA & Protein Explainers
items.description: Interactive 3D narrated explainers on chromosomes, DNA, genes, the double helix and how proteins fold.

items.name: ashtadhyayi-explorer
items.title: Aṣṭādhyāyī Explorer: Pāṇini's grammar, interactive
items.description: Pāṇini's Aṣṭādhyāyī, explorable: all 3,983 sūtras, interactive explainers, a derivation debugger, and Pāṇini & computer science.

items.name: quantum-mechanics-explainer
items.title: Quantum Mechanics: The Theoretical Minimum, animated
items.description: Animated, narrated deep dive through all ten lectures of Susskind and Friedman's Quantum Mechanics: The Theoretical Minimum, with interactive math. By Brijesh Shetty (github.com/brijs).

items.name: shastra-ai-explainer
items.title: Why Shastras in the Age of AI: A Decoded Talk
items.description: A narrated, interactive explainer of a talk on why Indian scriptures matter in the age of AI: every Sanskrit verse decoded word by word, root by root, with Pāṇini's cases, kārakas and suffix rules animated.

items.name: learn-nyaya
items.title: Nyāya-sūtra, methodically
items.description: An animated, narrated, interactive walk through Gautama's Nyāya-sūtra: the sixteen topics, pramāṇas, the five-limbed argument, vyāpti, fallacies and the art of debate, with a logic lab and a debate arena.

items.name: how-engines-work
items.title: How Engines Work
items.description: A 3D, narrated garage tour of how motorcycle engines work: four-stroke cycle, cams and valves, cooling, oil, fuel and exhaust, engine layouts, torque vs power, and Royal Enfield dyno curves.
